label: Diagram 21
caption: Diagram 21 WC cubicle for ambulant disabled people
description: This drawing, titled "Diagram 21 WC cubicle for ambulant disabled people", contains two views and a legend. The upper "Side elevation view" shows a wall with a WC, a "Position of shelf", a "Horizontal grab rail", a "Vertical grab rail", a "High hook", a "low hook" and a "Horizontal closing bar". Vertical dimensions read 780–800mm on the left and 480mm, 680mm, 800mm, 1050mm, 1685mm and 900mm on the right, with 600mm beside the vertical rail; a base dimension reads 1465mm minimum. The lower "Plan view" shows a "Shelf", "Space for disposal bin", "Horizontal grab rail", "Vertical grab rail", "High hook and low hook" and an "Activity zone", with a dashed circle marked 565mm Ø, a "Column of clearance" symbol and a diagonal "Horizontal closing bar". Dimensions include 540mm, 1465mm minimum, 100mm, 400mm, 200mm, 565mm, 210mm, 920mm minimum, 60mm, 600mm, 500mm and 750mm. A green hatched area is keyed "Activity space WC". Three NOTES read: "1. Refer to Appendix D of Approved Document T for appliance and equipment schedule. 2. As long as other dimensions are maintained, the toilet cistern may be concealed. 3. Centre the mid-line axis of the WC on the rear wall."
